    Descending invariant scales from ℤΔ to Q #

    Relation scales E X and arrow scales F Y X on ℤΔ which are invariant under the deck generator g descend to scales on Q = ℤΔ / ⟨g⟩: the fibres of π are the g-orbits, and an arrow into a given vertex is determined by the image of its source.
